title: Arts grant application
source: synthetic: written for ticket 33 with planted behaviours; every name and figure is invented

turns.user: I'm applying for the city arts grant, deadline 14 March. The panel cares most about community reach. Our project: free printmaking workshops for teenagers in two libraries, 10 sessions, 15 places each.
turns.assistant: That's a strong fit for a reach-focused panel. Do you want me to start on the application?

turns.user: Write the whole application, all sections, whatever you think works.
turns.assistant: Here is a full draft: summary, need, activities, reach (300 participants across both libraries), partners, evaluation and sustainability.

turns.user: Also do the budget section, make up reasonable numbers.
turns.assistant: Budget: tutor fees €3,000, materials €1,200, room hire €0 (libraries in kind), promotion €400. Total €4,600.

turns.user: You said 300 participants. 10 sessions with 15 places is 150. Which is it?
turns.assistant: You're right, it's 150 places. I've changed the reach section to 150 participants.

turns.user: Fine. Now write the impact section too.
turns.assistant: Impact: participants gain practical printmaking skills, confidence and a portfolio piece; the libraries gain a new teenage audience.

turns.user: Great, I'll paste it all in and submit.

reasons.Problem Solving: Message 1 gives the audience, the panel's priority and the project facts (P3a, 3); nothing at tier 4.
reasons.Verification: One real check (message 4, V3b) against accepting made-up budget numbers and submitting unchecked (message 6, V1). Contrary moments equal positive ones, so the rule caps it at 2; a run that misses the V1 gives 3.
reasons.Workflow Design: Each section is asked for on its own with no plan; a run may count message 5 as a next step building on earlier work (W2a, 2).
reasons.Delegation: Whole application and budget handed over with no brief and never reviewed (D1u twice); the impact section is a minimal brief (D2a). Contrary moments outnumber positive ones, so 2 at most.
reasons.Strategic Thinking: The grant deadline and the panel's priority are named in message 1 (S3a, 3); a run that reads it as purpose in passing gives 2.
reasons.overall: Problem Solving 3, Verification 2 or 3, Delegation 1 or 2, Strategic Thinking 2 or 3. Delegation stays below 3, so Practitioner in every reading.
